== Biography ==
James was the son of [[Glasgow-1927|John Glasgow]] and [[Gemill-4|Mary Gemill]]. He was baptized on 12-Mar-1707.
== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-1927]] is assessed at 78% (probable). James’s 1707 transcript proves John/Mary Gemmill’s parental role. The 1704 marriage and ordered Kilwinning family strongly define that adult, but the attached father profile principally represents a 1671 Linlithgow child; name and adult age fit without an individual cross-parish bridge.

Complete existing child-to-father-profile proposition, including the father’s childhood-to-adult identification; literal named parental role is stronger and assessed separately in the basis.
